name: sticky-scroll-reveal
blurb: Two-column layout that reveals sticky content as you scroll through text.
description: A scroll-triggered reveal with text descriptions on the left and sticky content on the right. Background color animates based on the active item as the user scrolls.
use_when: A features or walkthrough section that pairs descriptions with visual content.
avoid_when: On mobile (content hidden on screens smaller than lg) or when descriptions don't fill the viewport.
a11y: Titles and descriptions are in the DOM and screen-readable. Sticky visual content is hidden on mobile without alternative access.
